what: The proposed drift guard only hard-codes grep assertions for the helper output and skills/shared/voting-protocol.md, while the two SKILL.md MAV copies are protected only by edit-in-sync prose and unrelated Markdown/foreground/reference linters.
scenario_or_breakage: A future edit that changes the canonical OOS clause in only skills/design/SKILL.md Step 3 MAV or only skills/implement/SKILL.md Step 5 MAV would still pass the planned case_canonical_text_drift_guard, dispatcher prompt tests, test-references-headers, and lint-foreground-markers because none of those checks grep the SKILL.md copies byte-for-byte. CI would not catch silent drift across two of the four canonical copies before merge.
suggested_fix: Revise scripts/test-render-voter-prompt.sh case_canonical_text_drift_guard to grep the same hard-coded canonical string against all four consumers: rendered helper output, skills/shared/voting-protocol.md, skills/design/SKILL.md, and skills/implement/SKILL.md. Update render-voter-prompt.md and the HTML comment to say CI explicitly guards all downstream literal copies, not just voting-protocol.md.
